title: Session Context — 2026-08-24
content:
## What was done
- Added logic to implement session logs in the dashboard's Dev Journal
- Resolved problem in the planner that caused it to default to the Generalist on every DAG.
- Resolved async issue in coordinator that was stalling Uvicorn
- Added telemetry instrumentation from core.orchestration up into coordinator.engine and into agents.base to enable Live Telemetry Trace
- Scheduled core.session for deletion and removed hooks from orchestration.py
- Added heartbeat to Uvicorn in daemon.py
- Added systemd service monitoring for charon service files in Integration Matrix dashboard
- Transformed CLI entry point into a thin client
- Added comparable logic for commanding charon to the Integration Matrix -> Charon Daemon dashboard [@Dev Journal](/docs/manual/journal-subsystem) 

## Where I left off
- Building out the '@' linking functionality between pages

## Next steps
- Implement native react router in the application
- Ensure adding an '@' symbol allows selecting a specific manual page
